summary: An excerpt from a fiction novel (Book 10, part 102) in which Lee-Daniel fires Joey Riel by phone, warning him that the company's investors are ordering firings and that the roadhouse will soon cut off his credit. Joey reacts furiously, and Lee-Daniel asks him to keep the news quiet. The passage then shifts to a ceremonial perimeter walk around a network "Rez," with investors, Joey Riel, Lee-Daniel and others splitting into four crews to walk the boundary while streaming video over the localnet and uplinks.
one_line: In a fiction excerpt, Lee-Daniel fires Joey Riel by phone, then the staff walk the perimeter of a networked Rez with investors.
key_facts: Lee-Daniel phones Joey Riel and tells him he is fired.
Lee-Daniel says the firings are coming down from the investors and include Joey Riel, Elaine and all customer service reps except the two most senior antennamen and switchgirls.
Joey Riel reacts by saying "What the fuck ?" and cursing in three languages.
Lee-Daniel tells Joey Riel he may get severance at his old salary-level because he has just gotten his promotion.
Lee-Daniel warns that the roadhouse will cut off Joey Riel's credit, so he should make calls and line up money quickly.
Lee-Daniel asks Joey Riel to keep the news to himself, and the firings will happen in small groups after a head-count.
Joey Riel then calls his lawyer.
The perimeter walk is described as a purely ceremonial event initiated after the real post-install survey confirmed network integrity.
The group splits into four crews that walk the perimeter counter-clockwise, using ruggedized videoconferencing tablets with a two-by-two grid of feeds.
Data travels over the localnet and streams out over the uplinks to residents of other unwired sovereigns.
The investors walk with the Northeast party, along with Joey Riel, Meatloaf and Mermaid.
Lee-Daniel takes the Southwest corner with Elaine, the hard-line girl from the gate and Cobra.
Mac stays on the bus, where he usually spends dusks and dawns out of the mosquitos' range.
The investors struggle on the slippery humus in impractical Oxfords, and the day is a nice early-fall day with bloody sunset streaks.
